title: DatePicker
description: Picks a calendar date from a popup Monday-first month grid, or by typing a YYYY-MM-DD date.

keyboard.title: Keyboard and accessibility
keyboard.open: Arrow Down on the input opens the popup calendar and moves focus to the active day cell; clicking outside closes it.
keyboard.navigate: Arrow keys, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown (with Shift: a year) move focus across the calendar grid.
keyboard.select: Enter or Space picks the focused day and closes the popup.
keyboard.close: Escape closes the popup and returns focus to the input.
keyboard.typing: Typed text is committed immediately when it forms a complete YYYY-MM-DD date within range; on blur, flexible formats like YYYY/M/D are normalized.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected date as `"YYYY-MM-DD"` (controlled; pair with `onChange`). `""` or `null` means "no date" while staying controlled; `undefined` makes the picker uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected date as `"YYYY-MM-DD"` (uncontrolled)

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the input

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label of the input; without it the input is labelled "Date" (localized)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the input when no visible label is shown

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id(s) of the element(s) labelling the input; inside a FormControl it defaults to the FormLabel (unless `label` / `aria-label` is set)

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id(s) of the element(s) describing the input; merged with the helper / error text of an enclosing FormControl

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the input; defaults to the id of an enclosing FormControl

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required; defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the value without allowing changes (typing, panel, clearing); defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the input as invalid (aria-invalid); defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the input

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the picker; defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

props.name: clearable
props.description: Allows clearing the value with the suffix button

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the input

props.name: minDate
props.description: Earliest selectable date (`"YYYY-MM-DD"`); earlier days are disabled

props.name: maxDate
props.description: Latest selectable date (`"YYYY-MM-DD"`); later days are disabled

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the month heading (`Intl.DateTimeFormat`)

events.name: onChange
events.description: Called with the selected date (`"YYYY-MM-DD"`), or `""` when the value is cleared

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Called when the popup calendar opens or closes

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Click the input (or press Arrow Down) to open the popup calendar. onChange receives a "YYYY-MM-DD" string, or "" when cleared. Without label, the input is named "Date".

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Pass value and update it in onChange. "" or null keeps the picker controlled but empty, while undefined makes it uncontrolled.

examples.title: Default value and clearing
examples.description: defaultValue sets the initial date. The clear button is labelled "Clear date"; set clearable={false} to hide it.

examples.title: Disabled and read-only
examples.description: A disabled or read-only picker cannot be opened or edited.

examples.title: With FormField
examples.description: Inside FormControl / FormField, DatePicker inherits the id, label, helper / error text, required, disabled, readOnly and invalid states.

examples.title: Date range
examples.description: minDate and maxDate ("YYYY-MM-DD") disable dates outside the allowed range.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

cssVars.--date-picker-panel-width: Width of the popup calendar panel
cssVars.--date-picker-panel-radius: Corner radius of the popup panel (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--date-picker-panel-padding: Inner padding of the popup panel
cssVars.--date-picker-cell-size: Width and height of a day cell in the popup grid

basic.title: Native calendar
basic.description: Tap the field to open the calendar. Selecting a day commits a local YYYY-MM-DD string immediately; clearing emits an empty string. minDate and maxDate bound selection. The native field uses touch day buttons instead of text entry or a DOM keyboard grid.

basic.title: Bounded date selection
basic.description: Type YYYY-MM-DD or choose a date between October 10 and 20. minerva-change emits { value }; clearing emits an empty string. The value attribute initializes the field; form reset restores it.

props.readOnly: Shows the value without allowing changes (typing, panel, clearing).
props.hideClearButton: Hides the clear button (clearable={false} in React).
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled (itself or by a disabled <fieldset>).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element.
props.validationMessage: Message describing the current validation error (empty when valid).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation.
props.valueAsDate: The selected date as a local Date, or null when empty or invalid.

events.minerva-change: The date was committed, detail: { value } in YYYY-MM-DD format; an empty string when cleared.
events.minerva-input: The draft input changed, detail: { value }.
events.minerva-open-change: The user opened or closed the panel, detail: { open }; cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.

cssVars.--input-height: Minimum height of the field (defaults to the density's control height for the size).
cssVars.--input-radius: Corner radius of the field (defaults to --radius-lg).
cssVars.--input-focus-color: Border color while hovered or focused.
cssVars.--icon-button-color: Color of the clear button icon.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the clear button on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of the clear button while pressed.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of the clear button while pressed.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the clear button (defaults follow the density's control heights).
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Size of the clear button icon.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the clear button (defaults to --radius-lg).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner input.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the value is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error (an empty string clears it).
methods.formResetCallback: Called by the browser on form.reset(): restores the value attribute.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Called by the browser when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Called by the browser to restore the value (back/forward cache, autofill).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Bind v-model to a YYYY-MM-DD string or null. Choose a date, type it, or clear the field.

range.title: Date range
range.description: Only dates from October 10 through October 20 are selectable.

form.title: Form field
form.description: Inherits the label, required state and helper text from FormControl.

states.title: Sizes and states
states.description: Small, read-only, disabled, and non-clearable date fields.
